caption:
New product. New history.

A store can be years old while a new product has only one day of recorded prices. Keep those two things separate. Records from another product cannot fill in the missing days.

India Prior Price uses only prices it recorded for that product and variant. Products added later need their own full history before an eligible reduction can show the observed prior price.

No invented old prices. Coming soon. Follow for launch.
